sentences.text: Names of applicants - Ashfaq and Mohsin Mehbub are not seen in the FIR.
3. Considering the nature of the allegations, I find it appropriate to extend pre-arrest protection to the applicants.
I also find that prima facie serious allegations are not attributed to the applicants.
ORDER a) Issue notice to the Respondents, returnable on 20th June, 2024.
The learned APP waives service of notice on behalf of Respondents/State.
Call for papers from the concerned police station.

b) Applicants shall be released on bail in the event of arrest in connection with C.R. No. 128/2024 registered with Waluj Police Station, Tq. Gangapur, Dist. Aurangabad for offence punishable under Sections 272, 273, 328, 188 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 only on the condition of furnishing P.R. bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) each with one solvent surety.
